chunks.arabic_text: ٣٠٧٢ - وَرُوِيَ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ قَالَ:

translations.en: 3072 - It is narrated from Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ رَجُلٌ سَاقَ الْهَدْيَ فَعَطِبَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى مَنْ يَتَصَدَّقُ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّهُ هَدْيٌ

translations.en: I said to Abu Abdullah عليه السلام: A man drove the hady, and it became incapacitated in a place where he could not find anyone to give it in charity to, and no one would know that it is a sacrificial offering.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «يَنْحَرُهُ وَيَكْتُبُ كِتَابًا يَضَعُهُ عَلَيْهِ لِيَعْلَمَ مَنْ مَرَّ بِهِ أَنَّهُ صَدَقَةٌ».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He should slaughter it and write a note which he places on it, so that whoever passes by it knows that it is charity."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a sacrificial animal sent as hady that becomes incapacitated before reaching its destination. The Imam عليه السلام instructs that it should be slaughtered and marked with a written notice so that passersby know it is to be taken as charity.
en.seo_question: What should be done with a hady animal that becomes incapacitated before reaching its designated place?

key_terms.الْهَدْيَ: the sacrificial animal designated for offering in the rites of hajj
key_terms.فَعَطِبَ: became incapacitated, perished, or was ruined before arrival
key_terms.يَتَصَدَّقُ: to give as charity for the benefit of others
key_terms.يَنْحَرُهُ: he should slaughter it in the prescribed manner
key_terms.كِتَابًا: a written note or notice identifying its status
key_terms.صَدَقَةٌ: charity made available for others to benefit from
